prerequisites-C8: 'prerequisites-C8' in site-sandbox.test.ts checks facts, links and titles, no card for a record with no edge, and the site-absence, site-links and RT-2 gates passing. prerequisite-card.render.test.ts now checks every record in the real file: facts, routes, labels and titles.

findings_fixed: Card link titles not held (minor). rt-built readCard now reads each link's title. roundtrip-built expectedCards and compareCard compare 'label → route "definition"' (PrereqRow gained definition; new helper linkKey). The real-build RT-2 test now plants a wrong title and expects its own card.links finding, and the piece test has a title-only mismatch case. prerequisite-card.render.test.ts checks every record's link routes, labels and titles over the real file, so the card stays held after RT-2 retires. triage.md updated to match.

maturity-C3 silent default (major). The spec itself settles the head-O1 conflict: maturity's 'Absent when' line keeps the default only when the learning extension is absent. New site/src/lib/learning.ts has learningPresent(root), true when docs/data/learning-paths.json or prerequisites.json exists, and statusSchema(learning). content.config.ts uses them, so status is required with no default on this tree. The head-O1 sandbox has neither file, so it keeps its default and stays green. gen-search-index no longer writes `?? 'stable'`: a manifest entry with no or empty status is a finding naming the route, and no payload is written. The shared builtSite fixture's manifest now carries status: 'stable', as the real manifest does.

prerequisites-C9 (minor). Each payload page with an edge now carries optional `requires` and `related`: its neighbours' routes in the file's order. They come from loadCards. SearchPage gained both as optional fields, and pages with no edge carry neither. This adds about 60 KB over 271 pages; the payload was already over its budget before this.
loadCards cache (minor). It is now keyed on the file's mtime, so astro dev picks up an edit without a restart. Tested with utimes for an edit and a removal.

Hub badge not checked (minor). The maturity-O1 built test now checks /patterns/caching.html: badge under the H1, kb:level intermediate, status stable in the meta and the manifest. The badge check moved into a shared helper.
Chip styling (minor). .kb-status is now a dashed, square-cornered chip: purple for draft, red for deprecated, tokens only. Checked by screenshot in light and dark.
Card row layout (minor). .kb-prereq is a grid (max-content 1fr) with display:contents rows, and the list has min-width:0. Related links now wrap beside the label, as the screenshot confirms.
findings_rejected: Definition only in a title tooltip (minor, marked optional by the verifier). Not changed. Spec prerequisites-C8 asks only for links and facts. The definition is the linked page's own opening line, one step away. Showing it inline would roughly double the card's height on 271 pages, and putting hidden text inside the link would change the label that RT-2 and the render test hold. The tradeoff is now written in site/src/components/PrerequisiteCard/CLAUDE.md.
open: The search box UI does not yet show the new requires/related neighbours under a result. The payload carries them (C9's data half). Rendering them in site/src/components/Search is a UI change for the owner or the site component owner.
search-index.js is 5.9 MB against the 1.5 MB placeholder budget. This was already over before this lane (the edges add about 1%). The real budget is measured in P7.

The older fallbacks `|| 'stable'` in tools/src/site/site-portable.ts:815 and `?? 'stable'` in gen-site-hubs.ts:210 are still there. Neither can be reached on a learning tree now, because the schema makes the head meta always present. Owned by the site lane's code.
deviations: maturity-C3 is split on whether the extension is present, not simply dropped. Status is required when docs/data/learning-paths.json or docs/data/prerequisites.json exists, and defaults to stable otherwise. This follows the maturity unit's 'Absent when' line and keeps head-O1, which builds a page with no status in a tree without learning, true as written.
The prerequisites-C9 payload edges are neighbour routes, not record ids. Every route is a page in the same payload, so a result can name its neighbours by their titles without a second lookup.
No held patch. Nothing on this branch is false before the cutover, so plans/wave2/held/learning.patch was not created.
